note: A1+ Unit 3 Lesson 3.15, built on 2026-11-20 under the A1+ lesson standards approved 2026-10-27 and the user's 2026-11-09 rule that every A1+ lesson follows up the A1 lesson with the same number. The user approved the A1+ Unit 3 map on 2026-11-20 (A1+ 3.Y follows A1 3.Y, one step each; A1 Unit 3 has sixteen lessons after the alphabet lessons were removed the same day) and asked for the Unit 2 deal: straight to Preview in batches, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, no per-lesson gates, reviewed in Preview. The review uses ten new Flash photos of new people, one per Unit 3 step or pair of steps: a sister introduced at the front door, an older couple (she cooks, he eats), twin boys of twelve, a sister of seventeen and her brother of fourteen, a cook in a restaurant kitchen, a woman with short hair and a man with long hair, a man with a camera beside a woman in headphones, an old man at his door at 11 Park Street, a girl who wants to be a farmer and a class standing up. Each fact is offered as a picture item, whose wrong pictures are the other photos, and as a sentence item, whose wrong options change only the reviewed form.

lesson.title: 3.15 Review: new people, new homes
lesson.unit_title: Meeting people and talking about them
lesson.unit_outcome: Introduce people and answer introductions, use the short forms of be, answer yes/no questions in short, compare ages, talk about languages, nationalities and jobs, describe people, say whose things are, give an address and say what you want to be.
lesson.goal: Review every A1+ Unit 3 step with new people: introductions, short forms of be, short answers, ages, both, languages and nationalities, jobs, hair, 's, whose and hers, addresses with at, and want to be, with no new language.
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 3.15 Unit 3 Review: A1 reviews Unit 3 with fresh scenes; A1+ 3.15 reviews every A1+ Unit 3 step with ten fresh photos of new people and no new language: This is my … and Nice to meet you (3.1), she's, he's and they're with -ing (3.2-3.3), No, he isn't (3.4), three years older than (3.5), twins and both (3.6), a Spanish cook who speaks Spanish (3.7-3.8), What does he do? and works in (3.9), his hair is long (3.10), the man's camera (3.11), Whose …? and hers (3.12), lives at eleven Park Street (3.13) and wants to be a farmer (3.14). 2.5's but, 2.11's shorter and 2.12's Stand up and Sit down come back. Nobody in the photos speaks in the first person (the cast's voices belong to the cast), so the teacher asks and the co-teacher answers; nationality and language are said, never read from a picture.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Introduce and describe new people, say how old they are, what they do and want to be, whose things are and where they live, with every Unit 3 form, at a natural pace.
